verses.text: Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalani:
Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yinhtilal to sya'ilej wal sb'a heb' yet' ofrenda syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, yik manh chukok tz'aj in b'inaj yuj heb'. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to a tiknaik yet' t'a masanil tiempo, yalnhej mach junok yinhtilal heb' tz'ik'ankot juntzanh silab' t'a wichanh, haton juntzanh syak' heb' eyetisraelal t'ayin, tato manh wach'ok yaj jun tz'ik'ankot jun silab' chi' icha yalan ley, yowalil tz'ik'jiel t'a yopisio t'a wichanh. Ha in wal Jehová in swala'.

Malaj pax junok yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' syal swaan tastak to wik yaji tato ay lepra t'ay, ma ay tas tz'el t'a swinakil, palta hato yik wach'xo yaji icha yalan ley, ichato chi' syal swaani. Tato syam junok tas to manh wach'ok, junok chamnak, ma junok winak tz'el yinhatil, manh wach'ok tz'ajkani.
Manh wach'ok tz'ajkani tato syam junok nok' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yichanh ley, ma syam junok anima manh wach'ok pax yaj yuj yalnhej tasi.
Tato manh wach'ok yaji, max yal-laj swaan junok tas to wik yaji, masanto sb'ikel sb'a.
Hato yik tz'em k'u, wach'xo yaji. Ichato chi' tzaxo yal swaan masanil tas to wik yaji yujto yiktaxon yaji.

Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' max yal-laj schi'an schib'ejal junok nok' nok' heb', haton nok' tonhej schami, ma nok' scham yuj nok' kaltakte'al nok', yik manh chukok skan heb'. Ha in Jehová in swala'.

Al t'a heb' to sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il heb', yik max och smul heb', yik max champax heb'. Tato malaj yelk'och in cheknab'il chi' t'a yol sat heb', skot juntzanh tik t'a yib'anh heb', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel heb'.
Malaj mach syal swaan tastak to wik yaji tato malaj yuj sb'a yet' heb' winh sacerdote. Eb' tonhej ayek' posado t'a heb', ma heb' tonhej smunlaj t'a heb', max yal-laj swaan heb'.
Tato ay junok schekab' junok winh sacerdote manb'il yuj, mato ay pax heb' tz'alji t'a yol scuenta winh, a heb' chi' syal swaan heb' masanil tas to wik yaji.
Tato a ix yisil junok winh sacerdote syik' junok winak ch'ok yel t'a skal heb' sacerdote, maxtzak yal-laj swaan juntzanh ofrenda chi' ix, haton juntzanh tz'ak'ji t'a heb' winh sacerdote chi'.

Palta tato chamnakxo winh yetb'eyum ix, mato spuknak sb'a ix yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', malaj pax junok yune' ix, meltzajnak ix yik skajnajxi ix yet' winh smam chi', ichataxon ayik kob'esto ix, syal swaan swael winh smam ix chi'. Haxo pax juntzanhxo heb' manh yinhtilok heb' sacerdote, max yal-laj swaan heb'.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej to wik yaji, tato manh yojtakok to wik yaji, yowalil syak' sk'exul t'a jun winh sacerdote chi', syak'an jab'okxo t'a yib'anh jun ix yak' sk'exul chi'.
Palta a heb' winh sacerdote yowalil manh komonok scha' heb' winh chijok tastak syak' heb' eyetchonhab' t'ayin.

Tato ay junok mach komonnhej schi'an nok' chib'ej wik yaj chi', manh tonhejok syiloch winh sacerdote chi', palta yowalil a jun ix chi'an nok' chi', syak' nok' silab' yik spakok jun smul chi', yujto a in Jehová in ix in sik'kanel juntzanh nok' chib'ej chi' wikok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' eyetisraelal masanil juntzanh tik: Tato ay ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal, tzeyak' junok nok' nok' yik snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, mato tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani,
yowalil a junok nok' smam malaj jab'ok spaltail tzeyak'a' yik wach' tzin cha jun silab' chi'. Ha junok nok' toro, ma junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, ma junok nok' mam chiwa tzeyak'a',
palta manhok junok nok' ayoch syab'il. Tato ya'ay nok', max in chalaj nok'.

Yalnhej mach ex tzeyak' junok silab' yik junk'olal t'ayin, wach'chom yuj b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, ma tonhej tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'ani, yowalil a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel, ma junok nok' chiwa, malaj spaltail tzeyak'a', yik wach' tzin cha t'ayex.

Manh eyak' junok nok' nok' penaay t'ayin, icha nok' malaj yol sat, nok' lajwinak, nok' k'iich, nok' elnak junok makan sniwanil, ma ay syaxk'ail, ma junok yab'il t'ay. Ha juntzanh nok' icha chi', max yal-laj snhusjitz'a nok' t'a waltar.

Ha mach ex tz'el t'a he k'ol eyak'an junok nok' silab' t'ayin, a junok nok' wakax, ma junok nok' kalnel syal eyak'ani, wach'chom manh lajanok steel yok nok'. Palta tato a junok silab' ix eyak' he ti' eyak'ani, max in chalaj nok' icha chi' yaji.
Ha junok nok' lajwinak sk'een, ma pojnak, ma ik'b'ilel sk'een nok' chi', max yal-laj eyak'an nok' silab'il t'ayin. Manh he b'eyb'alej eyak'an juntzanh nok' chi' silab'il t'ayin.
Manh he cha juntzanh nok' nok' icha chi' t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik tz'och silab'il t'ayin, yujto manh tz'akanok yaj nok', max in chapaxlaj nok', xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' t'a winh:

Ayik tz'alji junok nok' yune' wakax, ma junok nok' yune' kalnel, ma junok nok' yune' chiwa, uke' k'ual yowalil skan nok' yet' snun, haxo t'a swajxakil k'ual, tzaxo yal snhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a wichanh.
Max yal-laj junnhej k'ual tz'aj smiljicham junok nok' snun yet' nok' yune'.
Tato tz'ak'ji junok silab' t'ayin yuj ak'oj yuj diosal, ujokab' icha t'a sleyal yik wach' tzin cha'a.
Hanhejtona', tze chib'at nok' t'a jun k'ual chi', max yal-laj skan nok' t'a junokxo k'u. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
B'eyb'alejek in cheknab'il, tze k'anab'ajanpaxi. Ha in Jehová in swala'.
Mokab' chukok tz'aj in b'inaj eyuuj, palta to tzin eyik'chaanh, yujto a in wal ix ex in sik'kaneli,
ix ex wik'anelta t'a Egipto yik tzin och he Diosalok. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
